unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Postcards always spoil my holidays.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 邮寄(post)的卡片(card)就是明信片(postcard)。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The postman delivers letters and parcels to our neighbourhood every morning.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：n. [C] (pl. postmen) 邮递员。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I like hot pot very much.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 组合词联想：hot(热) + pot(锅) = 火锅。装满热汤的容器就是“锅”。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Potatoes, a lot of potatoes.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆: po (破) + ta (他) + to (去) -> 破产的他去买土豆吃。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 磅(重量单位)；英镑(英国货币单位)
unit_vocabulary.syllable_type: 元音字母组合音节 (Vowel Team)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: This dictionary costs fifteen pounds in the UK bookshop.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：n. 磅(重量单位)；英镑(英国货币单位)。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The rain is pouring down.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音记忆：泼 (pour) 水。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Stay away from windows and power lines.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：pow（象声词，出拳的声音）+ er -> 力量，能量。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Well, practice makes perfect.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音记忆法：扑克提示（玩扑克需要提示来多加practice练习）

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Keep on practising Chinese.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: prac(做) + tise(练习)，不断练习practise

unit_vocabulary.syllable_type: 元音字母组合音节 (Vowel Team)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: People in the street praised them.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 被raise举高高就是得到了**表扬**。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Then I prepare my schoolbag for the next day.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 提前准备，pre-pare。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 礼物 `adj.` 现在的；出席 `v.` 展现
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: It's her birthday present.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: pre-sent 礼物，节日拆包乐无边。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The president gave an important televised address to the nation last night.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：n. 总统。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Press the red button if you need immediate assistance.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：v. 按；压。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: It's a pretty hat.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: p(胖)+retty(像ready)：胖女孩准备好变得漂亮了。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Read the conversation and complete the table.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: p (怕) + rice (大米) -> 害怕大米的价格上涨。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 自豪；值得自豪的人(或物)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The new sports stadium is the pride of the town.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：proud（自豪的）的名词形式是 pride，记住“骄傲”的发音口型较大（ai拉长）。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: My little brother is a pupil in a local primary school.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：adj. 主要的；初等教育的。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The prince, Edward, and the poor boy, Tom, are the two characters in Mark Twain's famous novel
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：p(漂亮)+rice(大米)→吃了漂亮大米长大的高贵男孩→“王子”

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Could you please help me print out two copies of this English worksheet?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：v. 打印。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Detective Sharp came to the prison.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 监狱（prison）里关着坏人。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Congratulations on winning the prize at the school music festival!
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：pr(仆人)+ize(看作ice冰)→仆人把冰雕刻得很好，得到了国王的“奖励”

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The passage is most probably an advertisement.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 形近辨析: probable (可能的) + -ly -> 大概率地 (probably)；注意和适当妥当 (properly) 区分。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We learn how to work out maths problems in class.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: pro (专业) + blem，专业难题。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: This modern factory can produce thousands of electric cars each month.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：v. 生产。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: People would send TV programmes around the world.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: pro + gram -> 电视台播放的节目单。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: It can show my progress.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根词缀法：pro-(向前) + gress(走) -> 不断向前走 -> 进步

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Our science teacher asked us to work in pairs on a research project.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：n. 生产项目，学校的课题。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The mouse promised to help the lion.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: pro向前+miss送：提前送出的话就是**承诺**。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: It is not difficult to pronounce this new word correctly if you listen carefully.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：v. 发音。
